ctx.x: Well, Joe was doing a lot of those things we're talking about, you know? And, of course, Wynonie Harris. Man, those guys could sing (unintelligible) and they were rockin' and swingin' far more than what these guys are doing now. You know what I mean. They -- and they were doing it natural, you know. They had another singer called Reverend Gatemouth Moore. When I say Reverend, I mean he did eventually turn to preaching. But I remember when this particular Reverend Gatemouth Moore was singing these blues back in…
